en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Sayf b. ’Umayra from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

One who recites “Surah Sajdah”, Allah will raise him on the Day of Judgment while his face would be like the snow (delighted) or like the sun till he would be presented before Allah, the Exalted and the Mighty:

It will be said to him: My servant, you had regularly recited the “Surah Sajdah” and you did not know its reward. If you knew what it is and what is its reward you would not be shortcoming in reciting it;
and I will soon give your reward. O Angels make him enter Paradise
and in it will be a palace of red rubies, and its doors and turrets arches. He will see its inside from the outside and its outside from its inside
and a thousand pageboys born there and living there, whom Allah, the Exalted and the Mighty, had selected.”
